title: agentic.staff_report.answered v1
description: FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape). The vigía answered a report a staff member filed through the staff agent (ADR-183 D7/D8): it confirmed or dismissed the finding (source "personal") with a note, and that note is the answer for whoever reported. Published by alebrije-mod-agentic (app/services/staff_report_publisher.py, from bitacora_vigia_cli op contestar_reporte and its hourly retry in run_bitacora_reconcile) on the events:notifications stream, not on the EventBus: like agentic.correction_expired it travels in the notification-trigger envelope that notifications-ex Events.Pipeline consumes (the stream field `payload` holds this JSON object), so this schema describes that flat object. Pipeline reads event_name; event_type carries the same constant for this registry (ADR-31). origin is "system" because Pipeline's OriginGuard accepts only human, system or synthetic, and synthetic would suppress the whole event; the QA marker travels only in payload.qa_origin. notifications-ex Workers.StaffReportAnsweredWorker delivers it to subscriber_id (the reporter): always in the bell, and by WhatsApp in the reporter's branch hours, only to a QA WhatsApp when qa_origin. Nothing clinical travels: the report's title and the vigía's note.

event_type.description: ADR-31 event type, the same constant as event_name.

event_name.description: The key notifications-ex Events.Pipeline routes on.

subscriber_id.description: The reporter's user_id (the same value as payload.reporter_user_id): who receives the answer.

origin.description: Pipeline OriginGuard origin; never synthetic (that suppresses the event).

payload.description: What the vigía answered and where to deliver it.

decision.description: The vigía confirmed or dismissed the report.

nota.description: The vigía's note: the answer for whoever reported.

titulo.description: One line with what the report said.

reporter_phone.description: E.164 of the reporter, when the report came by WhatsApp.

reporter_context_id.description: The reporter's branch: its clock decides the WhatsApp hours.

patient_conversation_id.description: The patient's chat the report points at.

staff_conversation_id.description: The reporter's chat with the staff agent; null when the report came from the panel.

qa_origin.description: True when the report came from a QA phone: the answer only reaches a QA WhatsApp.
